title: Refuse composition with an invalid domain
preconditions: For each requirements, prototypes and quality variant, use a separate disposable Saga containing otherwise valid records.

steps.action: In separate disposable copies, introduce an invalid record in requirements, prototypes and quality, then open the composed reader/query.
steps.expected_result: Each invalid domain prevents a partial composed result; the error identifies the invalid input.

expected_result: Refuse composition with an invalid domain.
